(ORDER LIST: 607 U.S.)
THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 13, 2025
ORDER IN PENDING CASE
25A376 CASTRO, SAMANTHA E. F. V. BRITO GUEVARA, JOSE L.
The application for stay presented to Justice Alito and by
him referred to the Court is denied. The motion of respondent for
leave to file a supplemental appendix under seal is granted. The
order heretofore entered by Justice Alito is vacated.
Justice Sotomayor and Justice Jackson would grant the
application.
